report.roast: 2W 1L, +33 LP. A winning stretch - screenshot it, frame it, it is not happening again. Averaged 11.0/5.3/13.0 (4.5 KDA), 7.8 CS/min and 61% kill participation. 5.3 deaths a game. Not inting by definition, inting by vibes. Low point: 6/6/4 on Hecarim. Delete the replay. Delete the account. Start again. Best game: 17/5/23 on Hecarim - proof he CAN play, which makes the rest of it even worse.
fixes: Stop dying: 5.3 deaths a game is too many - ward before face-checking, track the enemy jungler, and back off when your summoners are down.
Track objective timers - set up vision 1 minute before dragon/herald/baron spawn instead of arriving as it dies.
Stop coin-flipping fights - his wins came from playing with his team, his losses from trying to 1v9 like he's a streamer.
